item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:

Starlink speed restrictions have been lifted, restoring stable connectivity for Ukraine's military. Four people were killed in two drone attacks in Russia's Belgorod region. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Israeli airstrikes have hit a university campus in Gaza and a building in Nuseirat, killing three people, and separate strikes killed eight civilians including a child. The IDF is also targeting Hamas financing networks, reporting the killing of two terror operatives involved in funding the group. Visually and hearing-impaired children in Gaza are missing school because of the war. The conflict produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
